Question B-007-003-011.

Why the correct answer is right: A higher refracting region places the bending point farther above Earth, so the same general path intersects the ground farther away.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "It increases, due to the increase in critical frequency": It increases, due to the increase in critical frequency gives the right direction for the wrong reason; the question specifies region height.
- sourceIndex 2: "It decreases, due to the geometry of the signal path": It decreases, due to the geometry of the signal path reverses the geometry; a higher layer lengthens the path.
- sourceIndex 3: "It decreases, due to the increase in critical frequency": It decreases, due to the increase in critical frequency has both the direction and the stated cause wrong for this height change.
